methodology: One fresh backend worker and one parent-process loopback simulator per scale, run sequentially in a single parent process; RSS can include parent allocator/JIT retention from earlier cases. Concurrency 10; shared inventory poll interval 100ms; simulator policy 10ms minimum request spacing / 4 concurrent requests. 500ms warm-up then 2000ms steady out-of-stock CPU sample. CPU is process CPU including worker and simulator, expressed against one core. RSS is total process memory (parent + worker + simulator), sampled every 10ms from steady-state through approval readiness; worker heap sampled before stock. Stock latency uses persisted STOCK_DETECTED event timestamps relative to sending the local inventory change; allApprovalReady includes cart queueing plus snapshot IPC. No approvals or order submissions are sent. One sample per scale, no baseline or statistical regression claim.
